hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.command' | grep -qE '^\s*git\s+commit' && { git diff --cached -U0 | grep -E '(AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}|gh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]{36,}|sk-[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}|-----BEGIN [A-Z ]*PRIVATE KEY-----)' >/dev/null && { echo 'Blocked: staged diff looks like it contains a secret.' >&2; exit 2; }; }; exit 0
